subject: Onsite week — tight itinerary, propose split demo + async deliverables
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@pinecresthealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@pinecresthealth.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite week — demo request & tight itinerary

Alex — thanks again for agreeing to host our team during our visit the week of Sep 20. We have a very compressed schedule: leadership brief on Mon, field ops on Tue, and back-to-back vendor meetings Wed/Thu.

Would it be possible to fit a full product demo into a 45–60 minute window on Wednesday afternoon (Sep 22)? Our travel is multi-city so the rest of the team will be a little scattered (some arriving late on Sep 20). If that doesn't work we could do two shorter sessions split across Wed/Thu.

High-level goal: see core inference latency/cost controls, routing/fallback behavior, and an ops walkthrough for rollouts.

Thanks — let me know what you can do.

Olivia
Director, Solutions Delivery
Pinecrest Health
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@pinecresthealth.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@pinecresthealth.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite week — demo request & tight itinerary

Olivia — appreciate the heads-up about the itinerary. Quick note: Naomi (our solutions engineer) is on a planned family trip Sep 20–23 and won't be available for the full deep-dive on Sep 22. We can still support you in a couple of ways: 

- Option A (preferred): Split the demo into two focused 30-min sessions: 1) platform architecture, latency/cost levers, routing policies; 2) rollout/ops, monitoring, and a quick Q&A. We can schedule both on Wed/Thu afternoon to match your arrivals.
- Option B: One 45–60 min on Wed with Naomi joining asynchronously — we’ll record a short targeted walkthrough for the parts Naomi owns and share it up front. Grace O'Connor (Sr. SE) can run the live demo for the NA team.

I've attached a short agenda outline to this thread to show how we’d split topics. If you prefer, we can also send a pre-recorded 10–12 minute clip covering KV cache behavior and batching that you can watch before the live sessions.

Which option works better for you? If Option A, propose Wed 2:00–2:30pm PT and Thu 11:00–11:30am PT as tentative slots.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Barnes <olivia@pinecresthealth.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@pinecresthealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 07:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Onsite week — demo request & tight itinerary

Thanks Alex — quick add from my side: I can’t make the live Wed slot (family commitments), but happy to prep the recorded segment and be available for the Thu session if that helps. Grace — can you lead the latency/architecture portion if we go live on Wed? I’ll drop the 10–12 minute recording covering KV cache, batching, and quantization notes by Tue EOD (attached here as "agenda-outline.pdf" and a small recording stub).

Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
- Able to lead Wed 2:00–2:30pm PT live demo (latency + routing + fallback)

I'll take Thu 11:00–11:30am PT for rollout/ops and be on the line for Q&A remotely (phone).

Naomi
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@pinecresthealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@pinecresthealth.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite week — demo request & tight itinerary

Thanks everyone — Option A sounds great and splitting makes the most sense given our travel. Please go ahead and send calendar invites for the two 30-min blocks you suggested. Also send the short recording ahead of time so our ops folks can review before Wed.

For context, our VP of Product will join the Wed session for the architecture piece and our Head of Cloud Ops will dial into Thu for rollout specifics. If you can include 5 mins at the start of each session for our stakeholders to outline success criteria that would be ideal.

Looking forward to the sessions — Olivia
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@pinecresthealth.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@pinecresthealth.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Sep 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite week — demo request & tight itinerary (Confirmed)

Hi Olivia / Tom — confirmed and calendar invites sent:

- Wed, Sep 22 — 14:00–14:30 PT — Architecture & latency controls (Grace leading) — Google Meet link: https://meet.google.com/arch-redwood
- Thu, Sep 23 — 11:00–11:30 PT — Rollouts, observability & Q&A (Naomi leading remotely) — Google Meet link: https://meet.google.com/ops-redwood

Attachments included: agenda-outline.pdf (split agenda), redwood-demo-deck-v2.pdf (deck we'll reference), short-demo-recording.mp4 (10:30 single-topic walkthrough — KV cache + batching). The short recording is also uploaded here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c

If anything changes to your arrival times, flag me and we can compress or shift the start by 15 mins. See you next week.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192
